body:
For one successful native child run, the reply returned through `agent.wait` can differ from the result delivered to its parent. In a 13-character example, one path inserts a newline and the other preserves a space. A caller checking that the parent faithfully reported the child's answer then rejects the correct reply.

**Reproduction.** Use one completed assistant message with two distinct final text items: `"River "` and `"stones."`. Bind that message to one child run as its visible final. Run it through both the [native terminal reply producer](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/f25a10e929c2c0875b6d3a6f6e6a2936726af520/src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt-result.ts#L148) and the [parent's completion-result reader](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/f25a10e929c2c0875b6d3a6f6e6a2936726af520/src/agents/subagents/announce/subagent-announce-result.ts#L34). Give the requester a public reply that copies the delivered result.

| Child's final content | Terminal reply (JSON string) | Result delivered to parent | Handoff check |
|---|---|---|---|
| One text block, or two stream deltas assembled into one block | `"River stones."` | `"River stones."` | Pass |
| Two distinct final text items | `"River\nstones."` | `"River stones."` | Fail |

Both paths selected the same run and final message. In the failing case, the [handoff checker](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/f25a10e929c2c0875b6d3a6f6e6a2936726af520/extensions/qa-lab/src/subagent-handoff-reply.ts#L15) returns before it even reads the requester's transcript: no public reply has the spelling it expects. The expected behavior is that a caller can verify this short, untruncated result for the same child. Treating arbitrary whitespace as equivalent would lose information; dropping the run, public-entry, or branch checks would accept the wrong evidence.

**Evidence and scope.** Reproduced locally on Ubuntu 24.04 / Node 24.20 with the production text producers, run-bound final-message selector, wait projection, and checker from `f25a10e9`. The storage and public-reply envelopes were synthetic; no live provider or Gateway was invoked. The relevant producer and checker files were unchanged at `47eaf429`. This is distinct from a long answer hitting the 4,096-unit limit. The [October 22 live job](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/39724512539/job/119647320029) did not retain the child's block structure or the exact two values compared at timeout, so this reproduction does **not** establish the cause of that run.

Codex review: this still needs some work.

**Summary**
This issue identifies a current-source defect: the same multipart child answer renders differently in agent.wait and parent settlement, causing a valid handoff to fail verification.

Reproducibility: Current source deterministically renders ["River ", "stones."] as "River\nstones." for the terminal snapshot and "River stones." for parent settlement; this review ran no tests or live Gateway.

**Next step**
Align native completion rendering and establish a failing regression comparing agent.wait with parent settlement for the same two-block final.


<details>
<summary>Review details</summary>

Best possible solution:

Use one consistent visible-answer rendering contract for native terminal snapshots and full parent completion results.

Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue?

Current source deterministically renders ["River ", "stones."] as "River\nstones." for the terminal snapshot and "River stones." for parent settlement; this review ran no tests or live Gateway.

Is this the best way to solve the issue?

Align the production rendering paths while preserving native part boundaries, complete-answer recovery, and strict handoff identity checks; whitespace-insensitive comparison would conceal the defect.

AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant.

Remaining risk / open question:

- The reported live-job timeout lacks retained block structure and compared values, so its connection to this defect remains unproven.

Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [ad407430c464](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ad407430c464737eec754309c7a6c40ef0d786ca).

</details>

<details>
<summary>Label changes</summary>

Label changes:

- add `P2`: A deterministic multipart-answer inconsistency breaks handoff verification, with no established widespread outage or urgent regression.
- add `impact:session-state`: Two projections of the same completed child run expose different answer text.
- add `issue-rating: 🦞 diamond lobster`: Current issue advisory state selects this label.

Label justifications:

- `impact:session-state`: Two projections of the same completed child run expose different answer text.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Evidence reviewed</summary>

Acceptance criteria:

- pnpm test src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt-result.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
- pnpm test src/agents/subagents/announce/subagent-announce-result.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
- pnpm test src/agents/tools/chat-history-text.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
- pnpm test extensions/qa-lab/src/subagent-handoff.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
- git diff --check

What I checked:

- **Terminal rendering inserts separators:** prepareTerminalAssistantReply uses prepareAssistantVisibleText; its renderer trims individual parts and inserts newlines between adjacent text blocks, producing River\nstones. for the reported input. ([`src/agents/embedded-agent-utils.ts:155`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/ad407430c464737eec754309c7a6c40ef0d786ca/src/agents/embedded-agent-utils.ts#L155), [ad407430c464](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ad407430c464737eec754309c7a6c40ef0d786ca))
- **Settlement renders the stored answer differently:** readSubagentRunAnnounceResultUsing selects the run-bound visible final and calls extractStoredAssistantText, which concatenates selected blocks without separators, producing River stones. ([`src/agents/tools/chat-history-text.ts:38`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/ad407430c464737eec754309c7a6c40ef0d786ca/src/agents/tools/chat-history-text.ts#L38), [ad407430c464](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ad407430c464737eec754309c7a6c40ef0d786ca))
- **Wait projection preserves the mismatch:** projectAgentJobObservation forwards snapshot.terminalReply directly, so agent.wait does not reconcile its text with the transcript rendering. ([`src/gateway/agent-turn/agent-job.ts:637`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/ad407430c464737eec754309c7a6c40ef0d786ca/src/gateway/agent-turn/agent-job.ts#L637), [ad407430c464](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ad407430c464737eec754309c7a6c40ef0d786ca))
- **Checker rejects a faithfully copied settlement:** The handoff checker derives its expected result from the terminal reply and returns before reading the requester transcript when no public result matches that spelling. ([`extensions/qa-lab/src/subagent-handoff-reply.ts:44`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/ad407430c464737eec754309c7a6c40ef0d786ca/extensions/qa-lab/src/subagent-handoff-reply.ts#L44), [ad407430c464](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ad407430c464737eec754309c7a6c40ef0d786ca))
- **Separate tests preserve conflicting contracts:** Attempt-result tests explicitly expect newline-separated native parts, while chat-history tests explicitly expect adjacent blocks to concatenate without separators; neither compares both producers for one child final. ([`src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt-result.test.ts:169`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/ad407430c464737eec754309c7a6c40ef0d786ca/src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt-result.test.ts#L169), [ad407430c464](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ad407430c464737eec754309c7a6c40ef0d786ca))
- **Documented completion contract:** The subagent announcement contract promises the completed run's complete visible final answer, with small answers intact: https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/subagents/announce. ([`docs/tools/subagents/announce.md:152`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/subagents/announce), [ad407430c464](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ad407430c464737eec754309c7a6c40ef0d786ca))

- **Free Wortley:** Raw commit e738c1467779af8e455ef41e8081cf10fa3c164c adds extensions/qa-lab/src/subagent-handoff-reply.ts:18 relative to its recorded parents. </details>
